method: Read-only inspection of cloned default-branch histories using git log/show/diff, regression tests, control follow-up patches, revert/hash/subject searches, and git -S/-L. Follow-up claims end at the cloned tips named in evidence. code_files contains every non-test changed file, including accompanying documentation; code_lines_changed counts source-file additions plus deletions, including source comments and blank lines. Randomization used Python random.Random(20261012): sort cases by (project, full SHA), shuffle and assign rb01..rb36; randomly select four alphabetically listed projects to contribute two tuning bugs each, with the other four contributing one; shuffle each project's bugs in alphabetical project order and allocate accordingly. In alphabetical project order, shuffle each project's controls, putting one in each half when there are two; shuffle the four singleton controls and allocate two to each half. Finally shuffle tuning, then heldout. Each half has 12 BUG and 6 CONTROL, with bugs from all eight projects.

cases.ground_truth:
BUG: Applying a new-file hunk beginning '@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@' computes insertion position -1, corrupting the order of inserted lines. Applying the regression patch to '' should produce 'line1
line2
line3
line4
'.
cases.evidence: Fix: Bad merge when adding new files (#189); test/patch/apply.js adds 'should create a file', applying that zero-old-line hunk to an empty string and asserting the four lines in order.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Changes YAML !!set representation from an object with null-valued properties to a JavaScript Set, including serialization support.
cases.evidence: Use real `Set` for !!set; checked C..origin/master through 78326247 with every subsequent set.ts patch, -S on setTag and container.add(key), and revert/hash/!!set/real-Set searches. Subsequent file edits add documentation only; no corrective fix or revert was found.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: A short option ending in '=' is parsed as flag characters instead of an explicit empty value. parser(['-o='], {alias: {o: 'opt'}}) sets o and opt to true and creates an '=' flag instead of returning {_: [], o: '', opt: ''}.
cases.evidence: fix: parse short option with trailing equals and empty value (-o=) as empty string (#541); test/yargs-parser.mjs adds 'should set a short option to an empty string when a trailing equals sign supplies no value', asserting the empty-string result and checking '-o=x' remains unchanged.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Calling inc on an existing SemVer object mutates that input because the constructor reuses it. For v = new SemVer('1.2.3'), inc(v, 'patch') returns '1.2.4' but also changes v.version from '1.2.3' to '1.2.4'.
cases.evidence: fix: ensure SemVer instance passed to inc are not modified (#427); test/functions/inc.js adds before/after JSON equality assertions in 'increment versions test'; the existing '1.2.3', 'patch', '1.2.4' fixture exercises this mutation.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Lexicographic sorting of timestamps can reverse an interval and falsely report no overlap. Intervals ['1970-01-01T02:00:00.000Z', '1970-01-01T03:00:00.000Z'] and ['1969-12-31T23:30:00.000Z', '1970-01-01T02:30:00.000Z'] incorrectly return false.
cases.evidence: Fix bug in areIntervalsOverlapping (#3628) (closes #3614); src/areIntervalsOverlapping/test.ts adds 'sort timestamp', asserting true for these overlapping intervals.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds the 'release' increment operation, which removes prerelease identifiers, and exposes it in the CLI.
cases.evidence: feat: add "release" inc type (#753); checked C..origin/main through 6e05b763 using file history, -S on the release case, -L on its implementation, and revert/hash/#753/release-increment searches. The class case is unchanged; inspected 3905343's CLI rewrite, which preserves release handling while warning about invalid increment arguments, and later identifier fixes do not correct this feature.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: A token made of hyphens followed by '=value' can populate the reserved '--' property with a scalar. Parsing '----=test' with populate-- true should leave '--' absent and preserve ['----=test'] in argv._.
cases.evidence: fix(populate--): -- should always be array (#354); test/yargs-parser.cjs adds 'should not populate "--" for key values other than "--"', asserting the literal positional token and undefined argv['--'].

cases.ground_truth: BUG: The code-span normalizer removes two spaces from content consisting entirely of spaces. Markdown '`   `' renders a code element containing one space instead of three.
cases.evidence:
fix: don't strip spaces from all-space code spans; test/fixtures/markdown-it/commonmark_extras.txt adds 'No stripping when a code span is all spaces', expecting '

'.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Image descriptions lose soft line breaks when converted to alt text, joining words across lines. '![here\nit is](https://github.com/executablebooks/)' gets alt text 'hereit is' instead of 'here\nit is'.
cases.evidence: Fix newline not rendered in image alt attribute; test/fixtures/markdown-it/commonmark_extras.txt adds 'Newline in image description', expecting the newline to survive inside the img alt attribute.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Record.equals treats every truthy argument as a Record and accesses its record-specific _keys field. Record({a: 1, b: 2})().equals(Map({a: 1, b: 2})) throws instead of returning false.
cases.evidence: Fix bug in Record.equals when comparing against Map (#1903); __tests__/Record.ts adds 'if compared against Map should return false', and __tests__/Map.ts adds 'does not equal Record with same values'. The surrounding recordSeq calls record._keys.map, explaining the exception.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Removes duplicated trailing-zero trimming from multiplication and simplifies the base-10 exponent calculation.
cases.evidence: Remove duplicated for-loop. Minor refactoring.; checked C..origin/master through b1d1e311 with decimal.js history, -S getBase10Exponent, -L on that helper and the multiplication tail, and revert/hash/helper-name/subject searches. Those changed regions have no later edits; later reverts concern README advice, with no corrective fix or revert of this refactor found.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Repeat.lastIndexOf returns the collection size instead of its last valid index, and empty repeats incorrectly report a match. Repeat('x', 3).lastIndexOf('x') returns 3 instead of 2; an empty Repeat's matching searches return 0 instead of -1.
cases.evidence: fix(Repeat): lastIndexOf returned size instead of size - 1; __tests__/Repeat.ts adds 'indexOf and lastIndexOf return the first and last index' and 'lastIndexOf on an empty Repeat returns -1', covering matching and absent values.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Replaces default-value type strings with an enum and computed property keys while preserving default-value selection.
cases.evidence: refactor: quote properties used for meta-programming; checked C..origin/main through aa386be6 with both files' history, -S DefaultValuesForTypeKey, -L covering defaultForType and guessType, and revert/hash/subject/enum-name searches. Those functions and enum references are unchanged; later fixes address other parser branches, with no corrective fix or revert found.

cases.ground_truth:
BUG: A whitespace-only block scalar is rejected when the next mapping entry is less indented, because indentation validation runs before recognizing the scalar's end. load('a: |+
   
b: 1
') throws instead of returning {a: '
', b: 1}.
cases.evidence: Fix whitespace-only block scalar followed by a less indented line, close #802; test/core/parser/parser.test.mjs adds 'ends a whitespace-only block scalar at a less indented line', covering this input, a nested variant and a genuinely invalid indentation case.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Adding or subtracting a multiple of five business days from a weekend can leave the result on a weekend. From Sunday 2019-08-18, amounts -5 and 5 yield Sundays 2019-08-11 and 2019-08-25 instead of weekdays 2019-08-12 and 2019-08-23.
cases.evidence: Fix addBusinessDays when input date is a weekend day (#1628); src/addBusinessDays/test.js adds 'starting from a weekend day should land on a weekday when reducing a divisible by 5', asserting both corrected dates.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Stores normalized reference labels in metadata on reference-link and reference-image tokens.
cases.evidence: Store reference labels in token metadata, #938; checked C..origin/master through 3c51991c with both files' subsequent history, -S meta.label, and revert/hash/#938/reference-label searches. Neither source file has a subsequent commit; no corrective fix, naming reference or revert was found.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Calling cos on a negative Decimal mutates the input's sign while reducing the angle. With precision 10 and rounding 4, x = new Decimal('-14044.44444444444'); x.cos() changes x to positive '14044.44444444444'.
cases.evidence: Fix for issue #20; test/modules/cos.js adds this negative input and asserts x.valueOf() still equals a freshly constructed original after x.cos(); the mutation was reproduced from historical source in memory.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds an optional date-construction context to endOfSecond so callers can request results in a chosen time zone.
cases.evidence: Add tz support to endOfSecond; checked C..origin/main through 717ce0a8 with full subsequent patches at the original and pkgs/core paths, -S on toDate(date, options?.in), and revert/hash/endOfSecond searches. Later edits change types, import extensions, formatting or location; runtime context forwarding is unchanged, with no corrective fix or revert found.
